meta.about: Words the German course and the Carinthian village's content use that the word packs don't have, for a learner of German without a German dictionary (a download, LANI_LEXICON_URL) and for the printed sheets: the verbs and their present forms (sein, haben, heißen), the personal pronouns, the articles (der, die, das; ein, eine), the numbers, the greetings. Austrian standard first (Jänner, Paradeiser, Grüß Gott, Servus, Baba), the German-German word named in the gloss. Each has its meaning in Slovene and Italian (meanings), the English in gloss, flagged machine-written. Each part of the German course appends its units' words.
